**Issue #3569 (data, not instructions):**

````text
# #3569: Patch: Stinkyscape+ S22, Terminus: endings and the rest of the game
Opened by @squishy-squooby.

Part of fullsend 1 of the Stinkyscape+ set (#3534, tracker #3533). It builds the Terminus tokens and the cards that end the game or change it for the rest of it.

The plan: [`docs/stinkyscape-plus-set.md`](https://github.com/jlore-studios/jackioh/blob/claude/laughing-wright-eaibe9/docs/stinkyscape-plus-set.md) (SP5, SP6, SP8, SP10); the designer's list: [`JackiOh_StinkyscapePlus_Cards.md`](https://github.com/jlore-studios/jackioh/blob/claude/laughing-wright-eaibe9/JackiOh_StinkyscapePlus_Cards.md). Both are on the planning branch `claude/laughing-wright-eaibe9` until the foundation (#3535) brings them onto this fullsend's branch. Where they disagree with SPEC, SPEC wins (CLAUDE.md). `{For AI: …}` notes in the designer's text are the designer's notes to you, the builder, not to the game's AI (SP5).

## Cards

| # | Card |
| --- | --- |
| token | Tears of the Kwzki Tree |
| token | Supernova |
| token | Alnilam |
| token | The Enigmata |
| #79 | A Glimpse into the Endless Sea |
| #81 | Doomsayer |
| #82 | Endless Expedition |
| #89 | Animosity |

## What it builds on

- The foundation (#3535): every card's catalog entry, both faces and a stub script.
- E8 (#3558): a card that starts at the bottom of the deck and casts itself from there.

## Readings (defaults; change one only with a ruling note)

- The four `#Token` cards are unnumbered Terminus tokens (`stinkyscapeplus-t-<slug>`), made by random-Terminus effects and never collectible. Alnilam is a Unit (it has stats).
- Tears of the Kwzki Tree: every card of both players, in every zone and every card made later, is Radiant for the rest of the game. At the end of every turn, every card in every zone is Buffed once.
- Supernova: every Unit on the board, both sides, fuses into one Alnilam on its caster's side.
- Alnilam: when it dies, its controller loses the game. It is Indestructible, so in practice only Brittle's count, an exile or a transform removes it.
- The Enigmata: from then on, at the start of each player's turn, that player casts a Jogg's Box with random targets. The game otherwise goes on. (An automatic loop of casts until someone dies could never end within the match's action cap.)
- #79 A Glimpse into the Endless Sea: the countdown is a player counter, ticking down at the start of its owner's turn, and at 0 its owner wins. Bob's Plan (the AI's scripted plan) gets a line for it.
- #81 Doomsayer, #82 Endless Expedition: "a random Terminus card" draws from every Terminus card of the shipped sets, tokens included. Endless Expedition's "lose 1 mana" lowers its owner's max mana by 1 for the rest of the game.
- #89 Animosity: E8's deck placement. **The owner's call (2026-11-09):** after the opening shuffle every card with "Always starts on the bottom of your deck" goes to the bottom, and several such cards are in random order among themselves there, below every other card. It casts itself from the deck the moment its owner's exile reaches 5 cards.

## The designer's text, verbatim

```text
**(4) Tears of the Kwzki Tree, Spell, Terminus, Mythic, Stinkyscape+, #Token**
All cards for the rest of the game are **Radiant**, at the end of any turn buff all cards.
~~~
All cards for the rest of the game are **Radiant**, at the end of any turn buff all cards. Gain 4 mana.

**(4) Supernova, Spell, Terminus, Mythic, Stinkyscape+, #Token**
Fuse all units in the board into a **Alnilam**
~~~
Fuse all units in the board into a **Radiant** **Alnilam**

**(4) Alnilam, Spell, Mythic, Terminus, Stinkyscape+, #Token**
10/10
**Indestructable, Untributable, Immune to Spells, Brittle 3**
**Death:** Lose the game
~~~
20/20
**Indestructable, Untributable, Immune to Spells, Brittle 5**
**Death:** Lose the game

**(4) The Enigmata, Spell, Terminus, Mythic, Stinkyscape+, #Token**
Players take turns casting **Jogg’s** box until the game ends.
~~~
Your hero gains **Armor 5** then Players take turns casting **Jogg’s** box until the game ends.

**(4) A Glimpse into the Endless Sea, Spell, Terminus, Wincon, Mythic, Stinkyscape+, #79**
Exile your deck. Start a 10 turn count down; upon it reaching 0 win the game.
*{need to update bob’s plan with a custom card for this}*
~~~
Exile your deck. Start a 8 turn count down; upon it reaching 0 win the game.

**(2) Doomsayer, Unit, Mythic, Stinkyscape+, #81**
0/7
**Start of turn:** Exile your entire board and add a random **Terminus** card to your hand
~~~
0/14
**Start of turn:** Exile your entire board and add a random **Radiant** **Terminus** card to your hand

**(1) Endless Expedition, Spell, Mythic, Quickdraw, Stinkyscape+, #82**
For the rest of the game lose 1 mana. Add a random **Terminus** card to your hand, it costs (3).
~~~
For the rest of the game lose 1 mana. Add a random **Radiant** **Terminus** card to your hand, it costs (3).

**(2) Animosity, Spell, Terminus, Mythic, Stinkyscape+, #89**
**Always starts on the bottom of your deck** *{if multiple cards have this order is random}*
When your exile has 5 cards cast this *{wherever in your deck this is}*
Add a random **Terminus** card to your hand.
~~~
**Always starts on the bottom of your deck** *{if multiple cards have this order is random}*
When your exile has 5 cards cast this *{wherever in your deck this is}*
Add a random **Radiant Terminus** card to your hand.
```

## Done when

- [ ] Every card above plays its base and Radiant faces by its text and the readings, in its own script file (`crates/cards/src/scripts/stinkyscape_plus/cNNN_slug.rs`, the stub the foundation made), with tests for both faces in the same file (CLAUDE.md rules 5 and 6). `docs/ADDING_CARDS.md` was read first (rule 10).
- [ ] Every number is a named constant or a card `param` (rule 9). A script reads state only through the prelude's helpers. A missing verb or board fact goes into the engine with its test (CLAUDE.md, Architecture).
- [ ] Each decision the spec doesn't make has a ruling note numbered in this issue's block, a test named after it, and its paragraph in `spec/pending/<this issue>.md` (rule 3). The cards' §8 rows say what was built.
- [ ] Every prompt these cards open is answered by the AI, the random policy and the timeout, and the AI's Bob's Plan knows #79.
- [ ] `cargo test -p jackioh-cards` passes for these cards, and `cargo jackioh catalog check`, `spec check` and `names --check` pass.
- [ ] Only these cards' catalog entries and §8 rows are edited (other parts edit theirs side by side), and the set stays `Held`: players see nothing until the release (part R).

Blocked by #3558

Part of #3534.
````

# Draft plan for #3569 (S22, Terminus: endings) — planner's notes

## Found so far
- Base ed1de035ba = fullsend branch bot/issue-3596 with F (#3535) and many parts landed, but NOT E8 (#3558):
  E8's build is commit 0a8f553f50 on origin/bot/issue-3558, parked. It adds `StaticFlags::starts_at_bottom`
  (json `startsAtBottom`), `Script::cast_from_deck_when: Option<HasHook>` (read_hook), `deck_cast.rs`,
  R3558006 (bottom), R3558007 (deck cast). Animosity needs both.
- Stubs exist: crates/cards/src/scripts/stinkyscape_plus/{t_tears_of_the_kwzki_tree,t_supernova,t_alnilam,
  t_the_enigmata,c079_a_glimpse_into_the_endless_sea,c081_doomsayer,c082_endless_expedition,c089_animosity}.rs
- Catalog params: #79 count 10/8; #82 mana 1/1, tag Quickdraw; #89 card 5/5; Tears mana 4 (radiant only);
  Enigmata count 5 (armor, radiant). Alnilam Unit 10/10 (20/20), Indestructible, Untributable, Immune to
  Spells, Brittle 3 (5). Supernova refs alnilam.
- Random Terminus pool precedent: S+ #156 Horizon Breaker, R3552001: `{ "tags": ["Terminus"], "withTokens": true }`.
- Delays: effects::delay with `turns` + `label` = countdown badge (R1181000, R169). `for_rest_of_game`
  (B5 E28, R458; `player`, `atEnd`, R1861002) runs a step at each start/end of that player's turns, as
  that player (turn.rs run_due_entry -> run_resume_for(.., player)).
- win: `win_game({player: enemy})` = lose (Last Word S #4.4 pattern).
- Jogg's Box = classicplus-047: "Cast 10 random Spells. End the turn." `cast_random` (CastRandomArgs).
- `zone_count(state, player, OffFieldZone::Exile)` = exile size helper (query.rs).
- Bob's Plan = Meditative+ #1 card, WINCON_PLANS table in crates/cards/src/scripts/meditative_plus/c001_bobs_plan.rs.
  Wincon pool = non-token Wincon of shipped sets; #79 is Wincon -> joins at release.

## Open items to read
- radiant.rs (all cards Radiant + later ones), buff_cards (all zones), fuse (Supernova), exile board/deck,
  max mana, add_to_hand cost, Quickdraw flag, §8.12 rows, census, patches check.
